tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Search PuraSIM travel eSIM data plans for a destination (country, region or global), cheapest first. Optional filters on price, data, validity and daily plans. Every plan includes a purasim.com link where the user can buy it.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Recommend the best PuraSIM eSIM plan(s) for a trip, from its length in days and the expected data usage (light, medium or heavy). Accepts one destination or a list of countries visited on the same trip (it then looks for plans that cover all of them).

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Full detail of one PuraSIM plan by its planId (as returned by search_plans or recommend_plan): coverage, mobile networks, data, validity, price and purchase link.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Answer "does a PuraSIM eSIM work in <country>?". Without destination, lists every PuraSIM destination (country, regional or global plan) that covers the country. With destination, says whether that destination covers it and with which mobile networks.

tools.name: get_destination_info
tools.description: Coverage (countries), mobile operators and network types (4G/5G), validity options and entry price of a PuraSIM destination.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List the destinations PuraSIM covers (countries, regions and global plans) with the entry price of each. Filter by type or name.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Return the purasim.com page of a plan with the plan preselected, where the user can review and buy it. No order is placed and no payment is made by this tool. With only a destination, the link opens the destination page.
